name: ModalConfig
title: ModalConfig.csv
description: Per-space wording for the pop-ups players see after an action. One row per space, visit and action. The game, the editor and the safety checks read this description, so a new column is declared once, here. Keys starting x- are this project's own hints.

fields.name: space_name
fields.title: Space name
fields.description: The space this pop-up wording belongs to.

fields.name: effect_action
fields.title: Which pop-up
fields.description: The action the pop-up follows, like draw_W, return_e, add (time), deduct (fee), dice, choice, negotiate, end_game.

fields.name: modal_description
fields.title: Description
fields.description: Replaces the pop-up's description. Can use {count}, {cardType} and {amount}.

fields.name: modal_button_label
fields.title: Button wording
fields.description: Replaces the Continue / Make Choice button.

fields.name: dice_value
fields.title: Only for this roll
fields.description: A die face (1 to 6) this wording applies to, or blank for every roll.
